keyPoints: Parmanu (atom) padarth ki sabse chhoti ikai hai jo rasayanik abhikriya me bhaag leti hai; har tatva ke parmanu alag hote hain.
Anu (molecule) do ya zyada parmanuon ka judkar bana samooh hai — paani ka anu H2O hai, oxygen ka anu O2 hai.
Dalton ke anusaar parmanu avibhajya tha, par baad me electron, proton aur neutron ki khoj ne bataya ki parmanu ke andar bhi sanrachana hai.
Rasayanik sanyog ke niyam kehte hain ki tatva hamesha nishchit bhaar anupaat me milte hain — paani me hydrogen-oxygen ka anupaat hamesha 1:8 hota hai.
Parmanu bhaar (atomic mass) carbon-12 parmanu ke bhaar ke 1/12 se tulna karke naapa jaata hai; ise amu me vyakt karte hain.
Anu bhaar us anu ke sabhi parmanuon ke parmanu bhaaron ka jod hota hai — paani ka anu bhaar 18 amu hai.
Aam galti: parmanu aur anu ko ek samajhna; oxygen ka parmanu O hai jabki prakriti me wo O2 anu ke roop me milta hai.
